scope: Static frozen-code/configuration review; final acceptance is separate

source_changes.all_other_10_runtime_modules: byte-identical, including robot USD composition root, robot config, env, residual/base controller, RGBD, axis, camera compatibility and startup proprio navigator

terminations.illegal_contact: selected base/torso/hip/thigh force norm >1N across original3-frame history
terminations.pre_reset_capture: RecordedTaskAEnv saves physics and active terms before super()._reset_idx

controller_data_flow.actor: Same331 inputs, same base/residual action history, same checkpoint; inference has no critic/terrain/root pose input.
controller_data_flow.recovery_sensor_inputs: Original proprio body linear velocity[0:3], body gyro[3:6], projected gravity[9:12], observed RGB/depth/intrinsics, sensor-estimated yaw/relative position.
controller_data_flow.computed_world_velocity: Recovery variable is estimated rotation @ body linear velocity; it is not a read of simulator world velocity.
controller_data_flow.prior_axes: Observed grid lines constrained by known fixed TaskA directions.
world_truth_outside_actor_nav: Internal camera sensor assembly/render poses and overview video

recovery_state_machine.candidate_seed: Full provisional XYZ and rotation in original initial-frame coordinates, with current camera as reference.
recovery_state_machine.candidate_rejection: Reseed at current image/full sensor-estimated pose and reset only candidate consecutive-accept evidence; original gap and episode budgets persist.
recovery_state_machine.promotion: Two consecutive candidate visual accepts; explicitly inertial_reanchor, not visually-connected old-map relocalization.
recovery_state_machine.timing: One observe_proprio at reset0 and once after each nonterminal env.step using absolute steps*.02; camera requires same timestamp and advances no sensor dt.
recovery_state_machine.heading: Validated independent heading can update yaw without resetting XY age; fresh flag prevents duplicate yaw interval.
recovery_state_machine.stop_gate: recovery_stop_required forces next controller command to zero before same existing policy; normal .8s stale-XY stop remains.
recovery_state_machine.extra_diagnostic_switch: 109→131 helper branch exists in runner but is disabled: original initial x−141, rough_speed enabled (parser rejects combining rough with diagnostic mode), no diagnostic metadata or helper snapshot.

success_contract: Only final reason reach_goal_x, sole active terminal term reach_goal_x, final.x>145 and reached_goal=true establish local completion; static audit does not establish outcome.
limitations: Inertial bridge uses simulator-reported proprio velocities whose short drift is inherited and unquantified.
Same render settings need not yield bit-identical RGB across independent GPU runs.
Official acceptance of known-course priors/custom robot remains outside this static implementation audit.
review_reuse_basis: All13 runtime module hashes and all27 dependencies freshly match the prior independently reviewed full_01; no changes to robot/env/physics/termination or recovery code.
